facts.statement: The Board has 14 directors: all 14 director nominees for election at the 2023 annual meeting are current Board members, each serving until the next annual meeting.
Board size was reduced from 15 to 14 directors when Anthony F. Earley, Jr. retired from the Board following the May 2022 shareholder meeting.
At the 2022 annual meeting the Board had 14 then-current members, all of whom attended.

Anthony F. Earley, Jr. did not stand for re-election at the 2022 Annual Meeting, served through that meeting and retired from the Board following it; his Compensation, Talent and Culture Committee service ended May 12, 2022.
facts.stated_time: 2022 Annual Meeting (May 2022); committee service until May 12, 2022

facts.statement: The Board determined nine directors have no material relationship with the Company and are independent: Kimberly A. Casiano, William W. Helman IV, William E. Kennard, John C. May, Beth E. Mooney, Lynn Vojvodich Radakovich, John L. Thornton, John B. Veihmeyer and John S. Weinberg.
64% of the 14 director nominees, nine nominees, are independent.
Chair of the Board William Clay Ford, Jr. is not an independent director under the Corporate Governance Principles.

In its independence determinations the Board found none of the considered business, financing and charitable relationships involving Mooney, May, Thornton, Weinberg, Earley, Kennard, Veihmeyer and Vojvodich Radakovich material.

The Board determined former director Anthony F. Earley, Jr. had no material relationship during his service and was independent, including under the heightened SEC standards for compensation committees.
facts.stated_time: during his service, which ended at the 2022 Annual Meeting

facts.statement: The Board determined Kimberly A. Casiano, Beth E. Mooney, Lynn Vojvodich Radakovich and John B. Veihmeyer independent under the heightened SEC independence standards for audit committees.
The Board determined John C. May, Lynn Vojvodich Radakovich, John L. Thornton and John S. Weinberg independent under the additional NYSE independence standards for compensation committees.
The Audit, Compensation, Talent and Culture, and Nominating and Governance Committees are comprised entirely of independent directors.

Each Audit Committee member is independent under NYSE, SEC and Corporate Governance Principles standards and satisfies the heightened SEC audit committee standards; all three current members, including Chair John B. Veihmeyer, meet them.
Each Compensation, Talent and Culture Committee member is independent and satisfies the additional NYSE compensation committee standards; its four current members are independent.
Each Nominating and Governance Committee member is independent under NYSE, SEC and Corporate Governance Principles standards.
Each Audit Committee member meets the financial literacy requirements of the NYSE Listed Company rules.
The Board determined and designated John B. Veihmeyer as an Audit Committee financial expert under SEC regulations and NYSE rules.
The CEO and Chair roles are separate: William Clay Ford, Jr. is Chair of the Board and Executive Chair; James D. Farley, Jr. is President and CEO.
William Clay Ford, Jr. has served as Chair of the Board since elected in January 1999 and was elected Executive Chair in September 2006.
The Board appointed John L. Thornton as Lead Independent Director, a role he has held since 2022.
The Board has five standing committees with published charters: Audit; Compensation, Talent and Culture; Finance; Nominating and Governance; Sustainability, Innovation and Policy.
Audit Committee: John B. Veihmeyer (Chair), Kimberly A. Casiano and Beth E. Mooney; three directors.
Compensation, Talent and Culture Committee: Lynn Vojvodich Radakovich (Chair), John C. May, John L. Thornton and John S. Weinberg; four directors.
Finance Committee: William Clay Ford, Jr. (Chair), Alexandra Ford English, Henry Ford III, William W. Helman IV, William E. Kennard, John C. May, John L. Thornton and John S. Weinberg.
William Clay Ford, Jr. has chaired the Finance Committee since 2007 and also held that position from 1995 until October 2001.

Nominating and Governance Committee: William E. Kennard (Chair), Kimberly A. Casiano, William W. Helman IV, John C. May, Beth E. Mooney, Lynn Vojvodich Radakovich, John L. Thornton, John B. Veihmeyer and John S. Weinberg.

Sustainability, Innovation and Policy Committee: William W. Helman IV (Chair), Kimberly A. Casiano, Alexandra Ford English, Henry Ford III, William Clay Ford, Jr., Jon M. Huntsman, Jr., William E. Kennard, Lynn Vojvodich Radakovich and John S. Weinberg.

During 2022 the Compensation, Talent and Culture Committee comprised Anthony F. Earley, Jr. (until May 12, 2022), John C. May, Lynn Vojvodich Radakovich, John L. Thornton and John S. Weinberg, none an employee or current or former officer of the Company.
Kimberly A. Casiano is a current director and nominee; independent director since 2003.
Alexandra Ford English is a current director and nominee; director since 2021, first elected at the 2021 Annual Meeting.
James D. Farley, Jr. is a current director and nominee since 2020 with no committee assignments (Committees: N/A).
Henry Ford III is a current director and nominee; director since 2021, first elected at the 2021 Annual Meeting.
William Clay Ford, Jr. is a current director and nominee; director since 1988.
William W. Helman IV is a current director and nominee; independent director since 2011.
Jon M. Huntsman, Jr. is a current director and nominee; director since 2020, having also served 2012-2017.
William E. Kennard is a current director and nominee; independent director since 2015.
John C. May is a current director and nominee; independent director since 2021.
Beth E. Mooney is a current director and nominee; independent director since 2019.
Lynn Vojvodich Radakovich is a current director and nominee; independent director since 2017.
John L. Thornton is a current director and nominee; independent director since 1996.
John B. Veihmeyer is a current director and nominee; independent director since 2017.
John S. Weinberg is a current director and nominee; independent director since 2016.
